description: Defines the LeaveEntitlementUsage class in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin, representing leave entitlement and usage data with properties and accessors.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementUsage
classes.description: Data transfer object for leave entitlement and usage details, including date range and number of days.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a LeaveEntitlementUsage instance with id, number of days, days used, date range, and length days.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave entitlement usage record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the leave entitlement usage record.

methods.name: getNoOfDays
methods.description: Returns the total number of days allocated.

methods.name: setNoOfDays
methods.description: Sets the total number of days allocated.

methods.name: getDaysUsed
methods.description: Returns the number of days used.

methods.name: setDaysUsed
methods.description: Sets the number of days used.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the leave period.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the leave period.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the leave period.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the leave period.

methods.name: getLengthDays
methods.description: Returns the length of the leave in days.

methods.name: setLengthDays
methods.description: Sets the length of the leave in days.
